settings.hero_img_alt: Four friends in Dockers clothing running hand in hand across a sunny hillside
settings.hero_body:
Since 1986, Dockers® has been making clothes that make getting dressed easier.

Born in California and built around the iconic khaki, we believe great style doesn't need to be complicated. Our clothes are designed to move with you, keep you comfortable, and look good wherever the day takes you.

From workdays to weekends, first meetings to last-minute plans, Dockers® makes everyday style feel effortless.

settings.brand_history_img_alt: Four friends in Dockers clothing posing on outdoor bleachers, two standing and two seated
settings.brand_history_heading: We Changed the Way America Dressed
settings.brand_history_body:
In 1986, Dockers® introduced a new way to think about getting dressed.

We took the classic khaki and gave it a more relaxed, modern attitude—creating a bridge between the formality of traditional workwear and the ease of everyday clothing.

Then came Casual Fridays.

Dockers® helped bring a more casual approach to the workplace, encouraging people to leave the suit behind without leaving style behind.

Because we've always believed you shouldn't have to choose between looking good and feeling good.

settings.brand_history_img_alt: Man in a brown blazer and pleated khakis leaning against sunlit stone steps
settings.brand_history_heading: The Khaki That Started It All
settings.brand_history_body:
Khakis have been around for generations. But we saw something more in them.

Versatility.

We made khakis that could go from the office to dinner, from Monday morning to Saturday afternoon. Over time, they became more than just pants—they became a way of dressing.

Today, the khaki remains at the heart of Dockers®.

Classic when you want it. Casual when you need it. Always ready for what's next.

settings.classic_menswear_img_alt: Four friends in Dockers clothing posing on outdoor bleachers, two standing and two seated
settings.classic_menswear_heading: Classic Menswear With a Modern Twist
settings.classic_menswear_left:
Dockers has spent almost forty years proving that comfort and tailoring were never actually enemies. The philosophy is simple to state and harder to execute: take the discipline of business-appropriate dressing and strip out everything that made it stiff.

In practice, that means flexible waistbands, fabrics that breathe, construction that resists wrinkles, and fits engineered around how men actually move rather than how a mannequin stands.
settings.classic_menswear_right:
Nobody at Dockers is asking you to choose between looking sharp and feeling human by six in the evening. That balance, more than any single product, is what makes Dockers khaki pants and chinos for men different from something that only looks good in a fitting-room mirror.

It's a small distinction until you're twelve hours into a day that started with a commute and hasn't slowed down since. That's when a pant either does its job or it doesn't, and Dockers has spent decades making sure it does.

settings.what_we_make_img_alt: Man in a grey sweater and dark denim standing on a grassy hillside
settings.what_we_make_body: This is still where Dockers does its best work. The fabrics are engineered to resist creasing and hold their shape, and the colors are chosen to pair with almost anything already hanging in a man's closet. Whether it's a smart casual look for the weekend or dependable workwear trousers for a five-day week, this is the pair men reach for without thinking twice.

settings.what_we_make_img_alt: Man in a navy pinstripe jacket and rust knit between city buildings
settings.what_we_make_body: Dress codes have only gotten looser since Dockers helped popularize Casual Friday, but the need for genuinely smart casual menswear hasn't gone anywhere. Dockers designs business casual apparel sharp enough for a client meeting and relaxed enough that you're not counting the hours until you can change.

settings.what_we_make_img_alt: Man in a black t-shirt and grey jeans under a concrete overpass
settings.what_we_make_body: The wardrobe has grown well past the original khaki. Men's and women's sportswear, activewear, outerwear, dress shirts, footwear and accessories now sit alongside the pants that started it all, all built on the same idea: comfortable, versatile design that performs as well as it looks.

settings.what_we_make_heading: What We Make: Men's Wardrobe Essentials, Done Right

settings.editorial_split_img_alt: Four friends in Dockers clothing running hand in hand across a sunny hillside
settings.editorial_split_caption: Comfort You Don't Have to Think About
settings.editorial_split_body:
If Dockers had to be summed up in one word, it would be comfort, and not the vague kind. Comfortable men's trousers that don't dig in during a long meeting. Wrinkle-free trousers that survive a commute or a flight and still look pressed when you arrive. Stretch waistbands, thanks to Smart 360 Flex™, that move with a day that never goes according to plan.

That's really what all-day wearability for men means at Dockers: clothes engineered to disappear into your day instead of interrupting it. The same thinking carries into fabric choice for men who travel often. Pieces are built to pack well, resist creasing, and adjust easily across climates and time zones, which is exactly what travel-friendly men's apparel should do without anyone having to ask. For anyone splitting a week between the office, an airport, and everything in between, Dockers has quietly become the low-maintenance menswear that just works.

settings.editorial_split_img_alt: Man in a brown blazer and pleated khakis leaning against sunlit stone steps
settings.editorial_split_caption: Dressed for Every Version of Your Day
settings.editorial_split_body:
Most men don't dress for one occasion anymore. They dress for a day that keeps changing shape without warning, and that's exactly the reality Dockers was built for: professional and casual clothing for men who need one wardrobe, not two separate ones.

A pair of Dockers chinos can move from a morning presentation to dinner with friends without a hitch, and that's by design, not by accident. It's why Dockers has earned its reputation as versatile daily menswear instead of a pile of one-occasion pieces. Buy less, wear it more, let each piece earn its place in the closet. That approach has carried the brand from a single khaki silhouette in 1986 to a wardrobe brand doing over a billion dollars in retail sales worldwide.

settings.editorial_split_img_alt: Four friends in Dockers clothing posing on outdoor bleachers, two standing and two seated
settings.editorial_split_caption: Style That Respects Where It Comes From
settings.editorial_split_body:
For a man navigating an air-conditioned boardroom one hour and a humid commute the next, modern workplace clothing has to work harder than most people give it credit for. Dockers was built with exactly that kind of unpredictability in mind. Fabrics are chosen to breathe in real heat, hold up over long days, and move easily between a corporate office, a client site, and a weekend with friends.

Dockers.in brings that same fit-first, comfort-first thinking home. The same design principles that helped build a global menswear brand since 1986 are now available for the Indian man's wardrobe, his workday, and his weekend. Whether you're starting a work-ready wardrobe from scratch or just looking for the one pair of chinos that finally replaces the five you've been rotating, Dockers is built to be the answer. It's the same brand that changed office dressing in California in 1986, just tailored for the climate, the commute, and the calendar of a working day in India.

settings.promise_img_alt: Four friends in Dockers clothing running hand in hand across a sunny hillside
settings.promise_heading: There's really one idea behind everything Dockers has made for almost forty years: comfort and style were never supposed to compete.
settings.promise_body: The brand didn't just join the business casual movement, it helped build it, and it's still redefining what everyday standards look like today. Not fast fashion. Decades of style, still evolving, still comfort-first. From the original khaki pant that helped invent business casual to the wardrobe essentials being made today, Dockers is still built around one goal: helping a man dress like he has somewhere to be, without spending his morning thinking about it.
settings.promise_closing: This is Dockers. The art of dressing easy, one comfortable, versatile, unmistakably Dockers piece at a time.
